purpose: Test smoother monotone post-hoc calibration families that can capture nonlinear reliability structure while reducing the small-sample variance of unconstrained isotonic regression.

scientific_boundary.inputs: immutable QFE V2 Layer4 raw CALIBRATION rows only
scientific_boundary.reason_select_is_not_confirmatory: the same CALIBRATION_SELECT outcomes were already exposed by QFE Layer4 V1 and may be used only as exploratory development evidence for V2.1

PLATT_ISOTONIC_BLEND.definition: q=(1-alpha)*q_platt + alpha*q_isotonic; both component maps fit on CALIBRATION_FIT only
PLATT_ISOTONIC_BLEND.monotonicity: guaranteed because convex mixtures of nondecreasing maps are nondecreasing

PLATT_CENTERED_MONOTONE_LOGIT_SPLINE.definition: piecewise-linear map in logit space with fitted knot output logits constrained strictly increasing; nonlinear deviations are L2-shrunk toward the fitted Platt map and penalized for second-difference curvature
PLATT_CENTERED_MONOTONE_LOGIT_SPLINE.tail_behavior: linear extrapolation using the positive first/last fitted segment slopes
PLATT_CENTERED_MONOTONE_LOGIT_SPLINE.identity_containment: the fitted Platt map is exactly reachable as zero nonlinear deviation

evaluation.paired_uncertainty: UTC-calendar-week block bootstrap of reference minus challenger
evaluation.coherence_gate: candidate transform must be nondecreasing on a dense probability grid and calibrated fixture ladders must remain nonincreasing in OVER probability as line increases
evaluation.selection_for_research_summary: within each candidate family report lowest SELECT Log Loss subject to Brier <= frozen reference Brier + 0.001; ties within 0.0005 choose stronger regularization / smaller alpha
evaluation.promotion_rule: NONE. No candidate can be promoted from this exposed exploratory comparison. A promising candidate must be frozen and tested on a new untouched future holdout or prospective cohort.

literature_rationale.beta_calibration: retained as comparator because it is a flexible monotone parametric family that contains identity-like behavior
literature_rationale.isotonic_risk: unconstrained isotonic is high variance on limited calibration sets
literature_rationale.recent_evidence: recent large-scale calibration benchmarks show Platt and isotonic can worsen log loss and motivate explicit method comparison rather than automatic recalibration
